items.title: Binance-Hack Launderers Reach Solana After Draining $500 Million on Tron, Chainalysis Says
items.summary: The firm says the Tron operation spanned more than 1,000 addresses and over 3,000 deposits before funds dispersed across chains.

items.title: AI agents bypassed crypto spending limits without human approval, researchers find in a new test
items.summary: The researchers say any approval an agent can reach is unreliable, and they built Countersign, an app tying approval to a physical action the agent can’t fake.

items.title: Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows after reopening withdrawals following record hack
items.summary: The exchange said the outflows equal 2.1% of its $171 billion in assets and that withdrawal volumes have declined after an initial spike.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Investors Head for the Exits After Record Binance Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs saw $643.2 million in outflows Friday, the first full trading session after the $6.4 billion Binance hack, ending October with roughly $516 million in net outflows.
